blocks.text: Already many events have taken place in January. One important event is Iran. There is much more to this than meets the eye. We are arriving at the time that the Scriptures must be fulfilled. The conflict with Iran over their nuclear program and the energy needs of the world has brought to pass an alignment with Iran. Russia, China, India, all of Asia, and Syria, the kings of the North, East and South, they have agreed to protect Iran in exchange for oil. But perhaps one important event is the exchange of oil for Euro currency. Sometime in March Iran will launch the Iranian Oil Exchange. So we see a major assault on the dollar. At this time all oil is traded for dollars. And at this moment there is a great energy war going on. Every country is bidding for the rights to drill for oil. China is buying major oil companies and the right to oil reserves. As one can see energy will change the course of history bringing us to these Scriptures, Rev. 13:16-17 and Rev. 6: 6 shows great shortages. – The world has sown the winds of strife, sins of lust, greed and living wickedly before God. And now it’s time to reap the whirlwind of judgment. Their financial house in the future is about the crumble. Energy will bring this about, bringing a dollar crises. More on this later. And now a wonderful quote from Brother Neal Frisby from Scroll #163.

THE SOON RETURN OF JESUS –In the hour we live in we are seeing the sign of world evangelism through printed publications, TV, satellite and all types of telecommunications, etc! The Lord said, “And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come!” (St. Matt. 24:14) – And there is hardly a spot left that has not been touched by the gospel. The Translation can take place in a short period ahead! Notice He said, “then shall the end come”, meaning what few spots are left will be covered by the two prophets to the Jews and the Tribulation Saints! (Rev. 7:4, 9-14) Plus the preaching of the different angels of the gospel (Rev. 14:6-15) – Right now at this very moment the Lord is gathering to Himself a special group of ‘believers’ of all tongues and nations! He has declared that His Bride will include people from every tribe and nation. And when this is accomplished He will return in a moment, in a twinkling of an eye! – And we are about to see a quick short work of this in the future!

PROPHECY – We have seen the sign of the days of Noah all around us. As predicted, the earth is filled with wickedness and violence! The cup of revenge and abomination is running over!…Nudity, drugs, sorcery and satan worship is now prevalent everywhere. And some of Hollywood’s motion pictures are playing a role in all of this among the nations!…We see also the signs of the days of Lot wherein we see the great commercial activity! The building, the buying and the selling unparalleled in history! We witness the exact immoral activities that existed at the time of Sodom. All of these conditions will worsen, beyond Sodom especially entering the Great Tribulation! (Luke 17:28-29) – We have seen the sign of the budding of the Fig tree. – After nearly 2,000 years the Jews returned to the Holy Land! – Luke 21:24;29-30 gives an exact super fulfillment of this prophecy! The times of the Gentiles are fulfilled, we are in a transition period!

PROPHECY OF PROTECTION – “As the age wanes out these words could well fit the elect of God! Ps. 124: 6-8, “Blessed be the Lord; who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth. Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped! – Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth!” – “ And He certainly will be with you and watch over you daily, as you trust in Him!” End quote.

Recently one of our partners went overseas and took a large quantity of Brother Frisby’s material with him. Many of the brethren gathered together and were able to see some of Brother Frisby’s videos for the first time. It was truly a great event for many of them to come together and share Brother Frisby’s ministry with each other. They had a wonderful time knowing that they were chosen by the Lord to witness this great ministry that was given, the hour of the Rainbow Angel working through His prophet giving the message to the Elect. A great blessing is on the Rainbow Prophets’ message. All that come in contact and believe will be blessed with the Rainbow prophets’ reward here on earth as well as in Heaven. My prayers are with you daily.

Due to the stressfulness of the world I am releasing a new DVD called “Stress Factor.” It will truly help you in your daily life. (See offer below.) – This month for all who write we will send a wonderful book called “The Cure for Doubt, Fear and Anxiety.” – The harvest days will soon be ending so let’s start the year off remembering the Lord with a good offering so that we can continue to publish and send as much of this gospel around the world. Jesus will prosper and bless you. Send your prayer requests. Your Brother in Christ,
